calls.title: Jake <> Brent weekly 1:1 - including discovery+demo
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies to enhance their sales outreach, emphasizing the importance of targeting high-value open source users and the Forbes Top 50 AI companies. They noted consistent lead generation from open source users, averaging one meeting per week, with a focus on companies with over 500 employees. Plans for outreach to the Forbes list will ramp up post-conference, excluding competitors like OpenAI. The team is enhancing contact data acquisition using Apollo and Dripify, with effective sequencing for multi-channel outreach. Additionally, a LinkedIn campaign was reviewed, showing good connection rates but low responses, necessitating follow-up efforts. The team's coordination and relationship-building activities during the forthcoming AI Engineer World conference were also highlighted to ensure focused outreach afterward.
calls.keywords: AI Engineer Conference, Open Source Outreach, Forbes Top 50 AI List, Contact Enrichment, Apollo CRM, LinkedIn Dripify Sequencing
calls.action_items:
**Jake Stangl**
Continue outreach to webinar attendees and open source users to maintain at least one meeting per week (07:00)
Filter Forbes Top 50 AI companies list to exclude current customers and companies with open opportunities before launching outreach sequence after July 6th (24:00)
Upload filtered AI Top 50 contacts into Dripify and Apollo, enriching with emails and mobile numbers via Apollo (17:00)
Pause drip campaign sequence in Dripify after uploading contacts to delay messaging start by 14 days (29:30)
Follow up with non-responding LinkedIn connections by adding them into Apollo outbound email sequences and phone call outreach (22:50)
Coordinate with Ryan on outreach plans to avoid overlapping prospect contact and confirm messaging strategy for AI Top 50 campaign (19:00)
Schedule and prepare for role play and demo session in week after next due to conference travel (26:40)

**Brent Holloway**
Provide follow-up support on LinkedIn and Apollo sequencing tools and filtering techniques (09:30)
Assist with uploading and managing contact lists in Sales Navigator and Dripify (12:30)
Share insights and best practices on multi-channel outreach and contact enrichment strategies (17:00)
Coordinate potential in-person meeting with Jake and team during AI Engineer Conference week in San Francisco (02:30)
